description:
Open a URL or URL scheme on the device.
Use when navigating to a web page or deep-linking into an app. On Chromium, this navigates the primary renderer to the given URL; a URL that does not load a page, start a download or run as javascript:, such as tel:, mailto:, an unknown scheme or no scheme, fails there.
Cross-platform schemes on native devices: https://, tel:, mailto:. iOS also: messages://, settings://, maps://. Android also: geo:, plus any app-specific deep link.
An https:// link opens the native app only if that app is verified for the link's domain (Universal Links / App Links); even then, an iOS simulator may open Safari. To reliably open an installed app, use its custom scheme (scheme://path) or launch-app.
On a physical iPhone, the app that receives the URL becomes the app under automation.
Returns { opened, url, note? }. `note` explains the routing caveat when a web URL was opened on a native device. Fails if no app is registered to handle the URI (iOS/Android) or the renderer rejects the navigation (Chromium).

bundleId.description: Physical iOS only: the app that receives the URL. Defaults to Safari for http(s); required for any other scheme.

udid.description: Target device id from `list-devices` (iOS UDID, Android serial, or Chromium id).

url.description: URL or scheme to open (e.g. https://example.com, messages://, tel:555, geo:37.0,-122.0).

name: open-url
